question: For each instance display name, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of migrations per instance, considering only instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record and are hosted on blaze8-12. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH instance_migration_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    i.uuid,
    COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count
  FROM instances AS i
  LEFT JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM instance_info_caches AS ic 
      WHERE ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid 
        AND ic.deleted = 0
    )
  GROUP BY i.display_name, i.uuid
)
SELECT 
  display_name,
  MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS range,
  VARIANCE(migration_count) AS variance,
  STDDEV(migration_count) AS stddev
FROM instance_migration_counts
GROUP BY display_name
